turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! How is your Thursday going down in Tucson?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey there! It's actually a really beautiful winter day here. Work at the clinic has been steady, but not too crazy. I actually ended up driving my hybrid in today instead of my usual commute, just because I need to run some quick errands right after my shift.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes sense! It's always nice to have the car handy when you have things to cross off your to-do list. How has your ankle been holding up lately? Fully back to normal?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, absolutely. It's completely healed up, thank goodness. I was even able to stand on it all morning without any issues. I just sat down for my break a bit ago and had a great lunch—I made a turkey and cheese sandwich using a few slices of the wild-yeast loaf I baked yesterday.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds delicious! There's nothing quite like a sandwich made with fresh, homemade sourdough. Did you get a chance to relax and listen to anything while you ate or on your drive in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! On the way here, I finally started listening to that creepy, real-life mystery show about unsolved cold cases that my coworker recommended a while back. I'm already hooked.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, the true-crime podcast! It's so easy to get sucked into those. I'm glad you're enjoying it. How are things going with Tom? Have you guys made any more progress on the wedding planning for this summer?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're actually making some good headway! Tom and I spent yesterday evening looking at some outdoor venue options. It feels a bit more real now that we're narrowing things down.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is so exciting! Summer 2028 will be here before you know it. I bet Dash is enjoying all the extra attention while you two are home planning. How is he doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Dash is his usual lazy self! He spent the whole morning roachin' on the living room rug. I swear, greyhounds are the biggest couch potatoes.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: They really are! He sounds like he has the perfect life. I hope the rest of your shift goes smoothly and you have a relaxing evening.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I appreciate it. I'll catch up with you tomorrow!
